mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS product_count, SUM(CASE WHEN shelf_status='1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS product_active FROM jonlink_product
SELECT COUNT(*) AS channel_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status='1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS channel_active FROM jonlink_channel
SELECT COUNT(*) AS salesman_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status='1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS salesman_active FROM jonlink_channel_user

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(premium),0) AS total_premium, IFNULL(SUM(profit),0) AS total_profit, COUNT(*) AS total_policy, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN up_settle_status='0' THEN premium ELSE 0 END),0) AS unsettled_up_premium, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN down_settle_status='0' THEN premium ELSE 0 END),0) AS unsettled_down_premium, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN up_settle_status='0' OR down_settle_status='0' THEN premium ELSE 0 END),0) AS unsettled_premium FROM jonlink_insurance_ledger

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ledger_date,'%m-%d') AS d, IFNULL(SUM(premium),0) AS premium, IFNULL(SUM(profit),0) AS profit, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM jonlink_insurance_ledger WHERE ledger_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ledger_date,'%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(ledger_date,'%Y-%m-%d')
SELECT IFNULL(insurance_company,'未填') AS name, IFNULL(SUM(premium),0) AS value FROM jonlink_insurance_ledger GROUP BY insurance_company ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT up_channel AS name, IFNULL(SUM(premium),0) AS premium, COUNT(*) AS cnt, IFNULL(SUM(profit),0) AS profit FROM jonlink_insurance_ledger WHERE up_channel IS NOT NULL AND up_channel <> '' GROUP BY up_channel ORDER BY premium DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT CASE shelf_status WHEN '1' THEN '上架' WHEN '0' THEN '下架' ELSE '未知' END AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM jonlink_product GROUP BY shelf_status
SELECT CASE policy_type WHEN '0' THEN '上游政策' WHEN '1' THEN '下游政策' ELSE '未知' END AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM jonlink_product GROUP BY policy_type
SELECT CASE deduct_tax WHEN '1' THEN '扣税' WHEN '0' THEN '不扣税' ELSE '未知' END AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM jonlink_product GROUP BY deduct_tax
SELECT IFNULL(company_name,'未填') AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM jonlink_product GROUP BY company_name ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT applicant AS name, IFNULL(SUM(premium),0) AS premium, COUNT(*) AS cnt, IFNULL(SUM(profit),0) AS profit FROM jonlink_insurance_ledger WHERE applicant IS NOT NULL AND applicant <> '' GROUP BY applicant ORDER BY premium DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(commission_amount),0) AS total_commission, IFNULL(SUM(premium),0) AS total_premium, IFNULL(AVG(commission_rate),0) AS avg_rate FROM fin_commission WHERE YEAR(create_time) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(create_time) = MONTH(CURDATE())

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time,'%Y-%m') AS m, IFNULL(SUM(commission_amount),0) AS commission, IFNULL(SUM(premium),0) AS premium, IFNULL(AVG(commission_rate),0) AS rate FROM fin_commission WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 12 MONTH) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time,'%Y-%m') ORDER BY m
SELECT IFNULL(insurance_type,'未分类') AS name, IFNULL(SUM(premium * 0.06),0) AS value FROM jonlink_insurance_ledger GROUP BY insurance_type ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count, IFNULL(SUM(amount),0) AS total_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN status='1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS issued_count, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN status='1' THEN amount ELSE 0 END),0) AS issued_amount FROM fin_invoice

SELECT id, policy_no, product_name, insurance_company, up_channel, applicant, insured, premium, profit, DATE_FORMAT(ledger_date,'%Y-%m-%d') AS ledger_date, CASE up_settle_status WHEN '1' THEN '已结算' ELSE '待结算' END AS up_status, CASE down_settle_status WHEN '1' THEN '已结算' ELSE '待结算' END AS down_status FROM jonlink_insurance_ledger ORDER BY ledger_date DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT name, debit, credit, value FROM ( SELECT s.subject_name AS name, IFNULL(SUM(e.debit_amount),0) AS debit, IFNULL(SUM(e.credit_amount),0) AS credit, CASE s.balance_direction WHEN '0' THEN IFNULL(SUM(e.debit_amount),0) - IFNULL(SUM(e.credit_amount),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(e.credit_amount),0) - IFNULL(SUM(e.debit_amount),0) END AS value FROM fin_subject s LEFT JOIN fin_voucher_entry e ON e.subject_id = s.id WHERE s.is_leaf = '1' GROUP BY s.id, s.subject_name, s.balance_direction ) t WHERE value != 0 ORDER BY ABS(value) DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_policy, SUM(CASE WHEN surrender_status = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS surrender_count, IFNULL(SUM(premium), 0) AS total_premium, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN surrender_status = '1' THEN premium ELSE 0 END), 0) AS surrender_premium, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN surrender_status = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) ELSE 0 END AS surrender_rate_count, CASE WHEN SUM(premium) > 0 THEN ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN surrender_status = '1' THEN premium ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(premium), 1) ELSE 0 END AS surrender_rate_premium FROM jonlink_insurance_ledger WHERE MONTH(ledger_date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(ledger_date) = YEAR(CURDATE())

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wx_mp_user WHERE subscribe = '1') AS fans, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wx_mp_user WHERE subscribe = '1' AND MONTH(create_time) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(create_time) = YEAR(CURDATE())) AS fans_month, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wx_qr_scan_log WHERE DATE(scan_time) = CURDATE()) AS scan_today, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wx_mp_template_msg WHERE status = '1' AND MONTH(create_time) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(create_time) = YEAR(CURDATE())) AS msg_sent, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wx_mp_template_msg WHERE status IN ('1','2') AND MONTH(create_time) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(create_time) = YEAR(CURDATE())) AS msg_total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wx_qr_scan_log WHERE is_new_follow = '1' AND MONTH(scan_time) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(scan_time) = YEAR(CURDATE())) AS scan_new_follow, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wx_qr_scan_log WHERE MONTH(scan_time) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(scan_time) = YEAR(CURDATE())) AS scan_total

SELECT IFNULL(insurance_type, '未分类') AS name, IFNULL(SUM(premium), 0) AS value FROM jonlink_insurance_ledger WHERE insurance_type IS NOT NULL AND insurance_type != '' GROUP BY insurance_type ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT policy_no) AS total_unique_policies, SUM(CASE WHEN cnt > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS renewal_policies, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT policy_no) > 0 THEN ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cnt > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT policy_no), 1) ELSE 0 END AS renewal_rate FROM ( SELECT policy_no, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM jonlink_insurance_ledger WHERE policy_no IS NOT NULL AND policy_no != '' GROUP BY policy_no ) t

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jonlink_product WHERE shelf_status = '1') AS total_products, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) FROM jonlink_insurance_ledger WHERE MONTH(ledger_date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(ledger_date) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND product_id IS NOT NULL) AS active_products, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jonlink_product WHERE shelf_status = '1') > 0 THEN ROUND( (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) FROM jonlink_insurance_ledger WHERE MONTH(ledger_date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(ledger_date) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND product_id IS NOT NULL) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jonlink_product WHERE shelf_status = '1'), 1) ELSE 0 END AS activity_rate
SELECT IFNULL(type_name, '未分类') AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM jonlink_product WHERE type_name IS NOT NULL AND type_name != '' GROUP BY type_name ORDER BY value DESC
